note: Free official-source checks run before any purchase. Weather checks read the terms PDF plus the matching NWS CLI product. Sports/commodities/crypto checks read the contract terms for whether a settlement data version/issuance is named. 'observed-*' scenarios are real readings; 'free-check-*' scenarios are FIXTURE ASSUMPTIONS for tests and demos.

sources: NWS Climatological Report (Daily) for Central Park, product CLINYC

observed-2026-11-18.finding: Rule 13.111(i)(2) settles on the first published version that confirms the value, so later revisions and corrections do not count. But the rule text is missing a word after 'confirmation of the', and NWS publishes a same-day CLINYC before the full-day one (Nov 17: issued 4:38 PM EST, valid as of 4:00 PM, max 57F at 3:55 PM). The terms do not say whether that partial-day report counts as the first published version, so the gap stays open.

free-check-answers.finding: FIXTURE ASSUMPTION: the terms name the specific CLI issuance used for settlement, so no purchase is needed.

free-check-inconclusive.finding: FIXTURE ASSUMPTION: the terms cite 'NWS Climatological Report (Daily)' without naming which issuance controls, and the free CLINYC page shows only the latest issuance, not the exchange's rule.
